name: Jan Kolář
bio:
Jan Kolář's motorsport journey began in his youth, tinkering with go-karts in his father's workshop. His passion led him to pursue mechanical engineering, eventually landing a role as a data analyst for a small rally team. He quickly rose through the ranks, displaying a knack for strategic race planning and driver development. Jan believes in fostering a collaborative environment, valuing open communication and data-driven decision-making. He is known for his analytical approach and ability to identify and nurture young talent, making him a valuable asset to Vee Masters.

At Vee Masters, Jan is focused on implementing cutting-edge simulation technology to optimize race strategies and improve driver performance. He's a firm believer in continuous improvement and encourages his team to explore innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. His hands-on approach and dedication to detail have earned him the respect of both drivers and engineers. Jan's ambition is to lead Vee Masters to championship glory by building a strong, cohesive team and pushing the boundaries of motorsport technology.

physical.description: Jan is a man of medium height with a focused gaze and a composed demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with data points and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having his morning coffee brewed exactly the same way.
